scope: Closed-run public eval code and small metadata/witness text only. No private reasoning, large model/proof decode, compiler import, native command, test, solver, benchmark, target reconstruction or new Agent.

structural_witnesses.contains: All 5031 original gate quartets, selectors, A/B expressions, topological outputs, fixed terminals, budget metadata, selected eliminations and retained intervals. Alternative contains counts/reason only.

selected_verified_result.gate_semantics: Each original quartet enforces y=A when selector x=0 and y=B when x=1; A is a nonnegative convex combination of original child outputs and B is one child. Every original child output has declared [0,1] bounds.
selected_verified_result.recorded_native_scope: MI forward/reverse objective-Equal affine inverse pair, plus reverse continuous objective-Equal inclusion. 3293 retained-coordinate observations per claim. No forward LP claim.
selected_verified_result.proof_pattern: Forward uses explicit binary-selector Cases to derive source-coordinate elimination equalities, then substitution. Reverse MI and reverse LP reuse target tightened rows plus selector bounds, and box bounds for remaining mapped output obligations.

proportional_candidate.formula: After caller-selected prior child substitutions: D=B-A, Dr=Br-Ar, D=alpha*Dr for the same selector x; reconstruct R_y=A-alpha*Ar+alpha*y_rep.
proportional_candidate.relationship_to_selected: Generalizes sharing identical normalized (x,A,B) triples to sharing (x,D/scale). Exact selected aliases are a special case when alpha=1 and A=Ar. The candidate has a different complete normalization and representative list; its kept set must not be guessed as the selected set minus 64 coordinates.
proportional_candidate.observed_attempt: Exact Expr arithmetic and independent unit-box sufficiency checks only. No alternative Proof completion, compile, native verification, final target, complete alternate maps or 197-coordinate failure table is saved.
proportional_candidate.box_failure_meaning: The maximum/minimum over independent retained [0,1] coordinates leaves the required interval. This does not show violation on the constrained target feasible set, and does not disprove the MI construction.

existing_API_MI_design.conditional_status: The existing rules can express these supplied local constructions. This static design does not assert that any unbuilt full alternate target/map satisfies all claims.

givens: Exact chosen representative, selector, alpha and D=alpha*Dr identity after the supplied child rewrites
Already proved source equalities for earlier eliminated children
Both original gate quartets and the selector's declared binary bounds
forward_proportional_equality.two_branches: Use cases(selector, kind='Eq', expect=y-R_y). In bit b, the existing active_gate pattern gives ey=y-C_b and er=y_rep-Cr_b (C0=A,C1=B). eq([(ey,1),(er,-alpha)]) proves the same y-R_y in both branches. Negative alpha is legal on EQ premises.

reverse_MI_bound_transfer.input_coordinates: Every expression and Fact is in the actual alternative target's coordinates. Forward source-scope Facts cannot be reused in a reverse claim.
givens: A complete fixed alternate mapping R for all original coordinates
For each retained gate, target-row proofs of its active equation in each selector branch; any omitted active row needs its own valid witness
Already proved lower/upper Facts for reconstructed child expressions, in the reverse MI root scope
reverse_MI_bound_transfer.induction: Follow the supplied original gate-output DAG. Original nonnegative A weights sum to one and B selects one child, so combine existing child Facts to prove 0<=A<=1 and 0<=B<=1. For a proportional output, active representative EQ gives R_y-C_b=alpha*(y_rep-Cr_b)=0 in branch b. Combine it with the child lower/upper Facts to derive -R_y<=0 and R_y-1<=0, and export those two LE Facts through Cases.
reverse_MI_bound_transfer.remaining_rows: Under the same bit branches, active original rows are equalities. Inactive original quartet rows follow from the known A/B child bounds and selector equality. All source rows, bounds, integrality, objective and any inverse/projection obligations still require complete Returns.
reverse_MI_bound_transfer.implication_for_197: A failed box-only bound may instead have a supplied row/child-bound/case proof. Explicit extra target bound rows are not logically necessary for MI if those witnesses succeed. The number of required branch proofs is not established from the count 197 alone.
reverse_MI_bound_transfer.no_search: The author supplies the representative, scalar, map, DAG order, rows and residual combinations. No automatic representative, cover, selector strategy or global proof search is proposed.

existing_API_MI_design.optional_inverse: If requested, the existing affine inverse claims can express a true full MI bijection when the complete maps and all inverse equalities are provided. The alternative does not inherit the selected target's inverse theorem merely because its formula is affine.

reverse_LP_boundary.why_MI_cases_do_not_transfer: A continuous selector may be fractional. Splitting at 0/1 and proving only its endpoints is not exhaustive for an LP domain; binary_value/VarInt cannot be assumed there.
reverse_LP_boundary.reconstruction_bounds: All original declared bounds on mapped coordinates remain obligations. For each of the 197 box-insufficient reconstructions, provide a continuous-domain constraint-based proof or retain the required mapped lower/upper inequality as an explicit target row. '197' counts expressions, not the exact number of necessary extra rows; a failed expression can need one or both sides, and other constraints may already prove them.
reverse_LP_boundary.further_gate_obligations: Retaining mapped [0,1] bounds alone is not generally enough to recover every removed original M=1 quartet for fractional selectors. Their mapped rows also need continuous-domain witnesses or must be kept/strengthened explicitly.

direct_transfer_sufficient_condition.givens: The actual retained representative quartet proves the perspective/McCormick inequalities for Dr in [Lr,Ur], with 0<=x<=1.
direct_transfer_sufficient_condition.sufficient: If Ly>=-1 and Uy<=1, the four mapped original M=1 rows follow from the appropriately signed/scaled representative rows and selector bounds. For alpha<0 choose the opposite representative row; every LE multiplier remains nonnegative.
direct_transfer_sufficient_condition.if_condition_fails: This direct transfer template is insufficient. It is not a counterexample. Supply other target-row combinations or explicit mapped original gate inequalities; their validity and cost must be checked on the actual alternate target.

reverse_LP_boundary.claim_policy: Do not silently drop the selected reverse-LP scope for a comparison. A later caller can explicitly choose an MI-only theorem, but it is a different scope. No alternate reverse-LP or forward-LP theorem is established here.

quality_tradeoff.known: The public candidate reports 64 further eliminations and 245 nontrivial affine shares; some maps contain two or three terms. The selected run explicitly preferred sparse aliases and box-bounded reconstruction.
quality_tradeoff.unresolved: Extra reconstructed-bound rows, mapped gate rows, denser substituted rows/objective and proof construction may change LP strength, sparsity and solver cost. Dimensions or a failed box check alone do not decide which formulation is better.
quality_tradeoff.comparison_requirement: Freeze complete alternate rows/maps/objective and the desired MI/LP contracts first, then separately verify the supplied proof and evaluate the same final solver artifact. No quality or capability-parity claim follows from this static plan.

required_missing_supplied_data: Full replacements2/actions2 table, kept2 and chosen representative/alpha for every proportional action, with dependency-closed retained-coordinate expressions.
Exact normal2 A/B expressions or a complete deterministic rewrite record proving D=alpha*Dr for every selected action.
The 197 coordinate names and per-side failed box extrema; summary counts cannot identify which witnesses or target rows are needed.
The complete actual alternate target variable order, rows, gate constants/omissions, bounds, integrality, objective and committed solver artifact.
Complete forward/reverse maps and explicit desired observations/inverse links/domain claims for that target; selected target maps and its 3293 observations cannot be relabeled as the alternate maps.
For reverse MI, explicit active-equation and child-bound residual witnesses where box-only completion fails.
For reverse LP if retained, explicit continuous proofs or target rows for every missing mapped bound and original gate row; the 197 bound count does not cover all such obligations.
execution_gate: No test38 reconstruction or regression is authorized/executed here. After quality stops, perform already prepared test70 regression first. Any later test38 execution needs a separately frozen supplied witness/target scope.
